date_note: Attack on Nov 8, detected Nov 10, fixed Nov 12; users informed Nov 18, which is the date used.
title: Chargemap tells users of data theft via old interface; password hashes exposed
summary: Chargemap says an outsider exploited a flaw in an old technical interface on November 8 to extract user account data, found on November 10 and fixed on November 12. Exposed data includes emails, usernames, contact details and password hashes; payment details, postal addresses and charging history are not affected. The CNIL was notified on November 13. The number of users was not disclosed.
plain: A French EV charging app says hackers took account details, including scrambled passwords, from an old part of its system.
exec: Large user base with reusable credentials; password hashes can be cracked and reused elsewhere.
action: Chargemap users: change your Chargemap password and any other account sharing it, and ignore unsolicited messages claiming to be Chargemap.

validation.note: Next and Cyberattaque.org agree on dates and data; Chargemap's help page returned HTTP 402 and was not read.
